newsitem.title: HUNGARY: HUNGARY APV ENDS ASSET TRANSFER TO SOC.SEC. FUNDS.
newsitem.headline: HUNGARY APV ENDS ASSET TRANSFER TO SOC.SEC. FUNDS.

text.p: Hungary's privatisation agency APV Rt said on Friday it had completed the obligatory handover of state assets to the social security funds, having transferred a total 55 billion forints.
"APV's board has decided that legal requirements have been met and will not single out further stakes for transfer to the social security funds," an APV statement said.
Hungary's social security system -- the healthcare and pension funds -- are a major burden for the budget. This year's social security deficit already stood at 62 billion forints in September.
The 1997 social security budget passed on Thursday night envisages a 13 billion forints deficit.
